body: New stage R34 THE FIGHT CAMP, greenlit straight after R33. Your task file is research/TASK_C20.md - top tier, effort medium, Fast off. One read-only get_camp_board(athlete_id, choices) on GameState.gd: it folds get_fight_camp_options / get_fight_camp_projection / get_fight_camp / get_fight_camp_report plus get_weight_status into ONE call and decides the STATE itself (setup / progress / report / unavailable) so the screen decides nothing. The new part is 'deltas': FightCamp.projection() returns absolutes, so a player choosing between hard sparring and a taper has to diff two projections by eye - given a _compare_against choices dict, return what each projected figure moved from and to with a tone (good/warn/bad/flat) from the PLAYER's point of view, so the screen never has to know which direction is which. Idempotent like C19; reuse your snapshot-and-restore of career if anything under it mutates. Invent no numbers - if a value you want does not exist, say so rather than deriving one. New test Godot/tests/camp_board_api_test.gd. Push your own deliverables.
